recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future work-group decision reopens instance-level implementation-guide version declarations; FHIR-12242 itself is satisfied by the existing CapabilityStatement-level declaration.
issue_request: FHIR-12242 asked for an implementation-guide version indicator on Meta so instances could identify the IG package/version to validate against. It was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add CapabilityStatement.implementationGuide 0..* instead, noting that this did not exactly satisfy the original Meta request but provided much of the solution.
initial_application: Jira records the application as svn revision 10286. The current Git history did not expose a FHIR-12242-tagged commit, but active current source already includes CapabilityStatement.implementationGuide 0..* and source rework/R4B history carried the element forward.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and Meta is an active datatype. Current CapabilityStatement.implementationGuide uses canonical targeting ImplementationGuide, which preserves the version-specific URI intent in modern FHIR form. The active Meta datatype contains versionId, lastUpdated, source, profile, security, and tag, with no IGVersion/implementationGuide element. Later FHIR-39433 clarified CapabilityStatement.implementationGuide versus CapabilityStatement.instantiates and is already reflected in the current source comment.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already reflects the approved CapabilityStatement-level solution, and adding the originally requested Meta element would be a new substantive change that FHIR-12242 explicitly did not approve.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the same CapabilityStatement.implementationGuide element's relationship to CapabilityStatement.instantiates and is already reflected in the current source.
